name: lz-vision-mixer-renderer
description: OGraf graphics renderer for LZ Vision Mixer: plays EBU OGraf graphics in offscreen Chromium windows and streams them with transparency to the mixer engine.
author: Lars Zumpe

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.pages.json && node scripts/copy-pages.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --publish never
